name: week
title: Supplier assurance: the week
subtitle: Read-only review snapshot. Evidence references require human verification.

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select * from assurance.review_queue order by reference

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select reference,name,kind,reason,basis from assurance.evidence_gaps order by reference,kind

sections.title: Open corrective actions
sections.sql: select s.reference,f.title,f.severity,f.owner,f.due_on from assurance.findings f join assurance.suppliers s on s.id=f.supplier_id where f.status='open' order by f.due_on

sections.title: Scorecards
sections.sql: select reference,name,period_end,delivery_score,quality_score,result from assurance.scorecards order by reference

sections.title: Recorded spend by currency
sections.note: Missing amounts stay unknown. Different currencies are never totalled together.
sections.sql: select category,currency,sum(annual_spend) recorded_annual_spend,count(*) filter(where annual_spend is null) unknown_spends from assurance.suppliers where state<>'archived' group by category,currency order by category,currency
